name: cli-status-row-heartbeat
description: M21 S6 origin, M22 D5 shape: one inbound, three Claude turns (tool_use, tool_use, final text) with the harness test clock advanced 61s then 90s as the scripted LLM calls are served. Pins the cli Task HUD transcript cadence deterministically: cli takes Behavior::Transcript (renders_client_side_transcript), so the batch boundaries surface as fresh Breadcrumb EVENTS carrying the elapsed clock ('1 tool call | 1:01', '2 tool calls | 2:31') plus cumulative steps, collapsed by 'done in 2:31, 2 tool calls' — never an update_breadcrumb edit. The pre-D5 StatusRows sentences ('Still working on this...') remain pinned for genuinely bare channels by hud.rs unit tests.
